title: Wright Field engineers and strange hieroglyph-marked material

tellings.quote: people at places like Wright Airfield, which was responsible for recreating the German pulse jet engine in 1943, are talking about material they've never seen before with weird hieroglyphics

plain: Between 1943 and 1947, people at Wright Field, a military airfield in Ohio that had rebuilt the German pulse jet engine in 1943, are said to have talked about material they had never seen before, marked with strange hieroglyphics. Michels tells this himself, in a debate with a skeptic, without naming a source. If true, it would mean engineers were handling unknown, possibly non-human material before the famous UFO stories of 1947.
